name: patient_is_consented_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has provided informed consent at the current time.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has provided informed consent at the current time.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has not provided informed consent at the current time.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has provided informed consent at the current time.

name: patient_is_pregnant_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently pregnant.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently pregnant.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is not currently pregnant.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently pregnant.

name: patient_sex_is_female_now

when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient's sex is female at the current time.

name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the numeric value of the patient's current age in years.

name: gestational_age_value_recorded_at_enrolment_in_weeks
meaning: Numeric value of the patient's gestational age in weeks at the time of enrolment.
when_unknown: Set to null if the gestational age in weeks at enrolment is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the numeric value of the patient's gestational age in weeks, as recorded at the time of enrolment.
